about_short_description.short_description: Silurian developed foundational models to simulate Earth, focusing on weather as the starting point.

product.name: Aurora
product.description: A foundation AI model that integrates high-resolution weather, air quality, ocean wave, and hurricane tracking forecasts into a single system.

product.name: GFT (Generative Forecasting Transformer)
product.description: A next-generation global AI weather model providing hourly, high-resolution forecasts with an expanded set of variables beyond Aurora.

product.name: GFT-US
product.description: A regional AI weather model providing kilometer-scale, short-term weather forecasts tailored for the United States.
